name: Lysias
description: A nobleman and one of the blood royal, left by Antiochus to oversee the king's affairs from the river Euphrates to the borders of Egypt and to bring up the king's son Antiochus; twice defeated by Judas, and later slain by the forces of Demetrius

points: But the King of kings moved Antiochus's mind against this wicked wretch: one day you are friends, and the Most High says, no, that is not your friend. Lysias informed the king that this man was the cause of all mischief, so the king commanded to bring him unto Berea and to put him to death: a tower of fifty cubits high, full of ashes, into which men thrust whosoever was condemned of sacrilege.
